== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=tg-03-city-of-light|Malachi Daiasus, also known as Overlord Malachi, was a high-ranking official serving the [[Damascan Kingdom]] under [[King Zakareth VI]]. As an Overlord, he managed a portion of [[Damasca]] and was responsible for overseeing annual human sacrifices, such as the raid on the village of [[Myria]]. While some perceived him as a distant and just leader, others viewed his actions through the lens of [[Damasca]]'s controversial practice of sacrificing citizens to protect the world. Malachi was characterized by his vanity, often favoring specific colors like purple and brown, and he possessed a [[throne]] made of amethyst and dark wood. Though some observers noted his competence and personal care for certain captives, he was ultimately killed by [[Alin]] during a confrontation. At the time of his death, Malachi was utilizing a powerful, broken [[The mask|mask]] that allowed him to channel immense energy from his [[Territory]], though the use of such an item caused him significant physical agony. Following his passing, his wife [[Adrienne]] assumed control of his realm, which became a target for [[Grandmasters]] seeking to destroy the [[Trees]] that support the Overlords' power.}}

=== {{spoiler|book=tg-02-crimson-vault|Legacy and Records}} ===
{{spoiler|book=tg-02-crimson-vault|As an Overlord and a [[Traveler]] of [[Naraka]], Malachi granted [[Erastes]] permission to retire.<ref name="tg-02-crimson-vault-c2">''The Crimson Vault'', chapter 2</ref><ref name="tg-02-crimson-vault-c6">''The Crimson Vault'', chapter 6</ref> The Overlord utilized a [[The mask|mask]] to summon terrifying amounts of power from his [[Territory]] and conducted a raid on [[Myria]].<ref name="tg-02-crimson-vault-c2" /><ref name="tg-02-crimson-vault-c5">''The Crimson Vault'', chapter 5</ref> During his reign, [[Leah]] was held in Malachi's hands for several weeks until [[Simon]] rescued her from his tower.<ref name="tg-02-crimson-vault-c6" /> Malachi engaged in combat with [[Simon]], who played a role in the Overlord's death.<ref name="tg-02-crimson-vault-c7">''The Crimson Vault'', chapter 7</ref><ref name="tg-02-crimson-vault-c10">''The Crimson Vault'', chapter 10</ref> Malachi is dead, having passed away one month before the council.<ref name="tg-02-crimson-vault-c4">''The Crimson Vault'', chapter 4</ref><ref name="tg-02-crimson-vault-c6" />}}
